# Cinou AI — full reference for language models

Cinou AI is an AI assistant web app (desktop + mobile) and Cinou Coder is its coding companion.
Both run on the same server ("Cinou engine") and are unlimited inside the app: there is no credit
system and no daily message cap. Upstream AI providers may still apply their own rate limits.

## How answers are produced
The Cinou engine routes every request through an ordered provider chain. Each provider call has a
timeout (default 45 s) and a total time budget, so a request never hangs forever. If one key is rate
limited it is put on cooldown and the next key is tried; if a provider fails, the next provider is
tried; finally a keyless free provider answers so the app keeps working with zero configuration.
Operators can add their own keys for OpenAI, Groq, Google Gemini and OpenRouter
(OPENAI_API_KEYS, GROQ_API_KEYS, GEMINI_API_KEYS, OPENROUTER_API_KEYS — comma-separated lists).

## Model family
| Model | Role | Default effort |
|---|---|---|
| Apex 5 | Flagship, hardest challenges | high |
| Apex 5 Think | Deep reasoning | max |
| C1 4.5 | Complex work + everyday tasks | medium |
| C1 Coder | Code generation / debugging | high |
| Spark 3 | Default, efficient | medium |
| C Lite 2 | Fastest | low |
| Spark 2.5, C Lite 1 | Legacy | — |

## Effort
low (short, fast) · medium (balanced) · high (thorough) · max (deepest, slowest).
Effort controls answer length budget and reasoning instructions.

## Developer API (OpenAI compatible)
Base URL: https://cinouai.onrender.com/v1
```
curl https://cinouai.onrender.com/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $CINOUAI_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"spark-3","effort":"medium","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Hello"}]}'
```
Any OpenAI SDK works by setting baseURL to the URL above and apiKey to your CINOUAI_API_KEY.
Keys look like `cinou_sk_...`, are shown once at creation and stored server-side only as hashes.
Operators can also preload keys with the CINOUAI_API_KEYS environment variable.

## Cinou Coder
- Web: /coder — editor tabs (HTML, CSS, JS), live preview, AI chat that can write code into the editor,
  quick actions (explain, fix, refactor, add comments, write tests), export to .html / .zip.
- Terminal: downloadable Node.js CLI (`cinou-coder`) that uses CINOUAI_API_KEY and CINOU_API_BASE.

## Contact / ownership
Cinou AI is an independent project. It is not affiliated with OpenAI, Anthropic, Google or Manus.
